protocol.mask: finite GT and GT-mapped source coordinate inside image; no prediction-dependent exclusions
protocol.aepe: mean valid-pixel EPE per pair; all pairs included in arithmetic pair mean
protocol.legacy_epe: sum valid EPE / sum valid pixels (unchanged project convention)
protocol.timing: median of 5 synchronized forwards including on-device model preprocessing and output interpolation; excludes disk IO, host transfer, GT and metrics
protocol.preprocessing: same native512 uint8 RGB pairs; GLU ImageNet/256 byte area resize; CRFT official64 uint8 bilinear resize + internal per-channel mean/std; CRFT flow resized/scaled to512

selection: minimum val coarse EPE within each arm; no test access
